DS-25 Typhoon Fixed Magazine Rifle 16″ (.308)
Built on a precision‑matched billet receiver set, the DS‑25 Typhoon is a workhorse rifle ideal for tactical or long range sport shooting, hunting, or patrol.  The DS-25 is a hybrid, combining the light weight and compact size of an AR-15 with the intermediate cartridge AR-10.  The DS-25 Typhoon is chambered in the venerable .308 Winchester providing increase range and stopping power over traditional 5.56 rifles.  Overall, the DS-25 Typhoon .308 Winchester is the SAME size and weight of a DS-15 Typhoon 5.56.  It features partial ambidextrous controls and an extended 13″ M‑Lok handguard ready for optics and attachments. The SOCOM‑profile 16″ barrel delivers long‑range accuracy without extra bulk. Up front, a Firestorm compensator cuts muzzle rise and felt recoil. A Hogue rubber over‑molded polymer pistol grip offers rock‑solid control in any condition.

Effective 03/01/2026: All rifles will ship with a Magpul DT Stock.

Available Finishes: Black

NOTE: Due to the anodizing process, color tints may vary.
Every firearm is hand‑assembled and individually tested at our factory in Rockledge, Florida, with all American‑made components and materials.

LIFETIME WARRANTY – Fully Transferable, No Registration or Proof of Purchase Required

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

Precision Matched Fixed Magazine Receiver Set	• Machined from US‑produced 7075 T651 aluminum
• Mil‑Spec Type III Class 2 hardcoat anodized finish
Billet Lower Receiver	• Threaded bolt catch screw
• Extended takedown & pivot pins
Billet Upper Receiver	• Mil‑Spec pinned forward assist
• Threaded forward assist screw
• Mil‑Spec dry film lubricated bore
Partial Ambidextrous Controls	• DSI Atach™ ambi charging handle
• DSI billet ambi 90° safety selector
• Mil‑Spec investment‑cast bolt catch
• Premium investment‑cast single‑stage trigger (4.5 lb. pull)
DSI DS-25 Bolt Carrier Group	• 8620 bolt carrier (diamond‑honed bore)
• 9310 bolt (enhanced profile) with .308 Bolt Face and Dual Ejectors
• 4130 gas key (Grade 8+ Torx‑staked)
• 8740 steel ground chrome firing pin
• Springco XP 5‑coil extractor spring
DSI 16″ SOCOM Profile Barrel	• 4140 CMV steel
• Button‑rifled; twist: 1:10
• Mid‑length gas system
• Black nitride heat‑treat finish
DSI Mil+ Carbine Buffer System	• Neoprene‑dampened buffer with bump‑stop
• Electropolished 17‑7 stainless spring
• Extended 7075 buffer tube (6‑position, drain/vent holes)
• Dry film lubricant in tube bore
• Dual‑staked QD end plate & castle nut
Included Accessories	• 10‑round fixed polymer magazine
• Keyed cable lock
Specifications subject to change without notice.
